# Test-time crop shift on finished runs (generated by `vl.shift_check --report`)

Validation, best checkpoints. A2 box per frame and camera (shift +-24 px, scale 0.9-1.0, clamped), same boxes for every run. none = fixed crops; both / side / wrist = which cameras get the A2 box. p_succ = mass above -0.5. Mean over 3 seeds per arm; ± = sd over seeds.

Max |V(none) - val_predictions V| per run (AMP noise only): lowlr_8k 0.0082, lowlr_8k_s1 0.0031, lowlr_8k_s2 0.0041, aug_full_s0 0.0051, aug_full_s1 0.0040, aug_full_s2 0.0068, aug_crop_s0 0.0074, aug_crop_s1 0.0069, aug_crop_s2 0.0075
